name: Mobile Murder Mystery
source:
Follow the story of the Unseen Narrator, whose repetitive life falls apart when their co-worker decides to quit on a whim.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4036110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
跟隨一位始終沒有露面的敘述者，看看一名同事心血來潮辭職之後，那日復一日的生活是怎樣分崩離析的。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4036110/]Steam[/url]］
